annotations.title: Test two users at once on PostgreSQL

description:
race_two_users({"sql":"CREATE TABLE public.quota(id int PRIMARY KEY, remaining int); INSERT INTO public.quota VALUES (1,1);","spec":{"rule":"Quota cannot go below zero","actors":[{"id":"A","role":"postgres","steps":["UPDATE public.quota SET remaining=remaining-1 WHERE id=1 AND remaining>0"]},{"id":"B","role":"postgres","steps":["UPDATE public.quota SET remaining=remaining-1 WHERE id=1 AND remaining>0"]}],"assertion":"SELECT remaining>=0 FROM public.quota WHERE id=1","evidence":"SELECT * FROM public.quota ORDER BY id"}})
Use this when two or three users could book the last slot, redeem one coupon, exceed a count limit, overwrite each other, or break another PostgreSQL rule at once. During a Supabase/Lovable launch or migration review, write a small test for the changed rule, then run it here without a terminal. Supply migration SQL or a public GitHub URL at an immutable commit, 2 or 3 actors with SQL steps or RPC calls, a boolean SQL assertion and an evidence SELECT. Runs real PostgreSQL 18.6 with offline Supabase fixtures; returns orders tried, broken orders, shortest observed broken execution, final rows, exact replay and a fix hint. Test a fix by calling again with changed migrations.
Limits: 200 KB migrations, 1 to 3 steps per actor, up to 240 orders/90 seconds. Capped results are incomplete. No live database, network SQL, private repo, arbitrary extension or JavaScript; sends no messages and stores only anonymous door/outcome counts.

commit.description: Resolved immutable commit SHA; a branch name is refused.

replayToken.description: From a previous result. Send the same input including maxOrders.

claims.description: Synthetic JWT claims only, never a signed JWT or real credentials

userId.description: Optional synthetic UUID; used as claims.sub

assertion.description: SELECT returning exactly one non-null boolean that must stay true

evidence.description: Read-only SELECT of the relevant rows, preferably with ORDER BY; max 25 returned

sql.description: Complete migration SQL, not a database connection string.
